lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno painted his thumb bright green,
And waited for the plants, so keen!
Kiki laughed, that's not the trick,
A green thumb means your plants grow thick!
[chorus]
Green thumb, green thumb,
Plants grow tall when you are done!
Green thumb, green thumb,
Water, sun and lots of fun!
[verse]
It means you're great at gardening,
Your plants grow tall, they love the spring,
You water, care, and give them sun,
A green thumb gets the growing done!
[chorus]
Green thumb, green thumb,
Plants grow tall when you are done!
Green thumb, green thumb,
Watch them bloom in the sun!
[outro]
So if your garden's looking keen,
You've got a thumb that's extra green!
